npcs.name: Captain Zhaon
npcs.description: Captain Zhaon is a weary Tamhiogal submarine captain stranded far from the waters and command structure that once gave his life meaning. He carries guilt like ballast, speaks with formal courtesy, and wants only to repair his vessel, honor his dead crew, and return to a home that may no longer exist. The Choral Synod distrusts him because old war captains are dangerous, but Zhaon's regret may be more useful than another generation of patriotic silence.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Eldavûn is a Town in Vaelmyrith, under Council Republic, with elevated danger, Beach and grass with water, Ocean Surface floating settlement, Beach and reefs with water terrain. Local records favor Neutral, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Elf — Sea Elf, Tortle, Genasi — Water Genasi. Tamhiogal reads through the Tamhiogal entry of the race compendium, within Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, marked by Bastveig. Aquatic Bettafolk of Hydromancy, Coral Stewardship, and Tidal Spirits. Table cues: ancestral instincts, homeland pressure, and local reputation; starting tendency Altruistic - Chaotic - Cooperative - Honorable.
rumors: Zhaon's submarine logs include apologies addressed to cities that were never warned.
He trades rare reactor parts for preserved seaweed tea and old maps of home currents.
plotHooks: Zhaon asks the party to recover a guidance core from a wreck before smugglers sell it as a weapon.
A coastal settlement wants Zhaon's vessel destroyed, claiming its old orders killed their grandparents.
